title: Family Planning Association of Pakistan
description: Rahnuma-FPAP is one of the largest and oldest civil society organizations in Pakistan focused on reproductive health and contraceptive care. The organization aims to empower individuals to make informed decisions about their sexual and reproductive health rights. It provides a wide range of services including family planning, HIV/AIDS care, gynecology, and obstetrics, particularly targeting vulnerable and underserved populations. Rahnuma-FPAP operates a network of clinics across Pakistan, ensuring accessible and confidential health services for all individuals.
